text: The diagnosis is done. Now Theo fixes the Subledger Accounting rule that's been misrouting standalone invoices all along.
The invoice distribution's own Cost Center becomes the primary source. The purchase order attribute only applies when a PO exists and that field is blank.
A handful of invoices get re-accounted correctly outright. The rest -- already posted -- get moved with one correcting journal, approved by Simone.
Theo adds a standing check to the close calendar, comparing every invoice's Cost Center to where it actually posted, every single month.
A safe-looking default can misroute real money for weeks if nobody checks the one case it doesn't fit. Totals matching isn't proof enough on its own.
